findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Potential unsafe deserialization or code injection
 * @description Detects usage of pickle, eval, and exec which can lead to code execution.
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/unsafe-deserialization-and-code-injection
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-502
 *       external/cwe/cwe-094
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("pickle").getMember(["load", "loads", "Unpickler"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("cPickle").getMember(["load", "loads", "Unpickler"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("_pickle").getMember(["load", "loads", "Unpickler"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("marshal").getMember(["load", "loads"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("shelve").getMember("open").getACall() or
    call = API::builtin("eval").getACall() or
    call = API::builtin("exec").getACall()
  )
select call, "Potential unsafe operation: " + call.getFunction().toString()
findings.hypothesis: Unsafe deserialization or code injection via pickle, eval, or exec.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Unsafe deserialization
 * @description Deserializing untrusted data using pickle or other unsafe methods can lead to arbitrary code execution
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/unsafe-deserialization
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-502
 */

import python
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("pickle").getMember(["load", "loads", "Unpickler"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("yaml").getMember(["load", "unsafe_load"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("marshal").getMember(["load", "loads"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("shelve").getMember("open").getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("jsonpickle").getMember(["decode", "unpickler"]).getACall()
  )
select call, "Potentially unsafe deserialization operation."
findings.hypothesis: Unsafe deserialization using pickle, yaml, marshal, shelve, or jsonpickle.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Inspect pickle.load arguments in fetchers
 * @description Inspect arguments passed to pickle.load in scipy/datasets/_fetchers.py
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/inspect-pickle-fetchers
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call, DataFlow::Node arg
where
  call = API::moduleImport("pickle").getMember("load").getACall() and
  call.getLocation().getFile().getShortName() = "_fetchers.py" and
  arg = call.getArg(0)
select call, "pickle.load called with argument: " + arg.toString()
findings.hypothesis: Unsafe deserialization of fetched data in scipy/datasets/_fetchers.py

/**
 * @name Trace argument to open in fetchers
 * @description Traces where the argument to open() comes from in scipy/datasets/_fetchers.py
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/trace-open-arg-fetchers
 */

import python
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call, DataFlow::Node arg
where
  call = API::builtin("open").getACall() and
  call.getLocation().getFile().getRelativePath().matches("scipy/datasets/_fetchers.py") and
  arg = call.getArg(0)
select arg, "Argument to open()"
findings.hypothesis: Trace the origin of the file path used in open() within fetchers.py to determine if it can be influenced by an attacker.

/**
 * @name Identify function containing pickle.load in fetchers
 * @description Identifies the function containing the pickle.load call at line 80 of scipy/datasets/_fetchers.py
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity info
 * @id py/identify-fetcher-function
 */

import python

from Function f, Call c
where
  c.getLocation().getFile().getShortName() = "_fetchers.py" and
  c.getLocation().getStartLine() = 80 and
  c.getScope() = f
select f, "Function containing pickle.load"
findings.hypothesis: Identify the function containing the vulnerable pickle.load call to trace its callers.
